title: Casts of a decimal and a timestamp to VARCHAR
verdict: the scale's digits and trimmed fractions; no leading zero when precision equals scale
description: A DECIMAL(p, s) prints its integer part, a `.` and exactly s fraction digits, with `-` for a negative (`10.50`, `-0.05`, `0.00`); scale 0 prints no `.` (`12`). When precision equals scale the integer part is omitted: DECIMAL(3,3) prints `.500` and `-.500`, DECIMAL(4,4) `.0001`. A negative zero does not exist (`-0.00` prints `0.00`). The widest decimal prints all 38 digits.

A TIMESTAMP prints `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` and the fraction without trailing zeros (`2024-01-05 09:30:00`, `…00.25`, `…00.123456`); the ends of the range print as `0001-01-01 00:00:00` and `9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999`.
reference: Open (#346): a reference text for decimals and timestamps is not decided; this records what DuckDB gives.

evidence.sql: SELECT CAST(CAST('10.5' AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(CAST('-0.05' AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(CAST('0' AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(CAST('12' AS DECIMAL(10,0)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(CAST('-0.00' AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS VARCHAR)
SELECT CAST(CAST('-0.5' AS DECIMAL(3,3)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(CAST('0.5' AS DECIMAL(3,3)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(CAST('0.0001' AS DECIMAL(4,4)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(CAST('0.05' AS DECIMAL(4,2)) AS VARCHAR)

SELECT CAST(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-05 09:30:00' AS VARCHAR), CAST(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-05 09:30:00.25' AS VARCHAR), CAST(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-05 09:30:00.123456' AS VARCHAR), CAST(TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00' AS VARCHAR), CAST(TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999' AS VARCHAR)

SELECT CAST(CAST(CAST('-0.5' AS DECIMAL(3,3)) AS DECIMAL(4,3)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(CAST(CAST('0.5' AS DECIMAL(18,18)) AS DECIMAL(19,18)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(CAST(CAST('-0.5' AS DECIMAL(37,37)) AS DECIMAL(38,37)) AS VARCHAR)
evidence.observed: -0.500, 0.500000000000000000, -0.5000000000000000000000000000000000000 (widening by one digit of precision gives the integer part; DECIMAL(38,38) cannot be widened)
